name: SPD Slow Cooked Wild Boar & Pumpkin
labelNotes: For adult dogs. The pack's guide is 450 g per 5 kg of body weight for a typical adult dog; HungryDog works the amount out from calories so it suits bigger dogs too.
Prime100 says to feed to body condition. Keep fresh water available at all times.

source.notes: Owner's pack (Australia), label photo, checked against Prime100's product page. Energy: label and page both give ME 65 kcal/100 g; label adds 230 kcal per pack (354 g x 0.65 = 230). Pack size 354 g from the product name on the maker's page (one size). Feeding guide on the label and page is only a rule: '450 g per 5 kg bodyweight' (label: 'of a typical adult dog'; page adds 'feed to body condition score'). No table at any other weight is published (the maker's site has an interactive calculator only), and the rule read in a straight line gives about 80% of a 1.6 x RER estimate at 5 kg but 134% at 40 kg, so no adultGuide is stored: the app feeds from calories (energy known) and shows the rule as a label note. AAFCO statement: adult dogs, so no puppy guide. Sold over the counter (not a vet diet), though listed as suitable for vet-prescribed elimination diets.
